newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar rebounds and ends at day's highs.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar rebounds and ends at day's highs.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures climbed from beneath unchanged to end a thinly-traded session firmer, as the speculators and the trade remained at a stand off on either side of the market, floor sources said.
Today's volume was estimated at a scant 9,355 lots.

Speculative buying lifted prices to the highs on the close. Interest met with trade scale-up selling which prevented the contract from reaching 10.95 to 11.00, the level that could give the market a push out of its current range, traders said.
"We're probably testing the upper range," one broker said.
Floor sources said the market's close at the highs could signal firmer prices next week.
Major support was seen at 10.60 in the March contract.
The spot March contract gained 0.08 on the day to settle at 10.93, having ranged from 10.93 to 10.77. The back months finished 0.06 to 0.01 firmer.
Open interest in March rose 414 lots to 85,645 lots.
